headline: Food and PROP sectors dominate today's activity with sharp price drops, high‑volume spikes and notable governance filings.
market_take: Across the coverage universe, food stocks experienced the most turbulence, highlighted by PQS's 15.66% fall, MADAME's 28.6% five‑day gain and multiple price‑gap alerts. PROP stocks also showed stress, with PF and GEL each down 20% and volume activity ranging from low to elevated. PF&REIT saw a dramatic -100% open‑gap for TNPF, while AMATA stood out as the sole large‑cap gainer (+9.65%). Governance signals emerged from MK PROP's connected‑person assistance receipt and NRF FOOD's auditor disclaimer.

sector_notes.note: Several food tickers triggered alerts: AQUA posted a +10% open gap then -9.09% intraday, MADAME showed a +6.86% gap and a 28.6% five‑day rise, and PQS suffered a -15.66% slide with volume 15.1σ above norm. NRF FOOD filed a high‑severity auditor‑change disclosure.

PF and GEL led PROP with -20% moves; other prop names (RML, CGD, A) also fell double‑digits, while AMATA bucked the trend with a +9.65% gain. MK PROP disclosed a connected‑person financial assistance receipt and a director change.
TTLPF dropped -14.97% on heavy volume and a 9.8σ volume spike, plus a -13.41% intraday move; TNPF recorded a -100% open‑gap, indicating a possible suspension.
DCON fell -16.67% on an 8.68× volume surge, while TOA slipped -9.04% and CCP rallied +7.41%.
CIVIL declined -12.15% with modest volume, reflecting broader construction slowdown.
UVAN posted a 9.7σ volume spike, and PPPM filed quarterly earnings.
